title: Architecture verification and quality gate strategy
workflow: Map requirement and invariant to independent review and executable cases
Build static schema/contract validation and negative scenario fixtures
Test failure behavior for duplicate, timeout, lost ACK and unavailable dependency
Execute money conservation, object authorization and reconciliation checks
Collect run commands, environment, logs and digests without inventing outcomes
Reopen failed controls and block acceptance until independently reproduced
requirements: A proposed test case is NOT a passed test
All money-moving APIs require idempotency, reversal and concurrency cases
External rail tests cannot claim real settlement without permitted participant evidence
Verify event schema evolution and replay against supported consumers
Include authorization bypass and cross-institution negative tests in every sensitive service
Independent reviewers must access actual logs, source commits and environment definitions
tests: Contract schema mismatch fails CI in future implementation
Replaying same command yields no duplicate journal
Unauthorized tenant object ID returns denied
Unknown outcome survives outage and remains unresolved
Every claimed test pass has run ID, environment, command and result evidence
gate: Executable harness, qualified reviewers, test environment and source/evidence correlation agreed.
